ts-search-intro: Search the labels and aliases of items, properties and domains. An ID such as Q42, or a domain such as wikipedia.org, goes straight to its page.
ts-search-none: No items, properties or domains match “$1”.
ts-createaccount-statement-help: Who you are and what you want to do here, for the people who review new accounts. At most 1,000 characters.
ts-createaccount-reviewed: This wiki reviews new accounts. Your request is read by a person before the account is created.
ts-createaccount-as-other: You are logged in as $1. The account you create here is for someone else, and you stay logged in.
ts-createaccount-userpage: Go to the user page of $1
ts-createaccount-requested: Your request for an account has been filed.
ts-createaccount-requested-next: Someone who reviews new accounts on this wiki will decide on it. Log in with the name and password you chose to learn the outcome.
ts-createaccount-failed: The account could not be created. Check the form and try again.
ts-createaccount-userexists: That username is taken. Please choose another.
ts-createaccount-noname: That is not a valid username. A username may not contain @ # : / < > [ ] | { } or start or end with a space.
ts-createaccount-badretype: The passwords you entered do not match.
ts-createaccount-passwordtooshort: A password has at least 8 characters.
ts-createaccount-throttle: Too many accounts have been created from your network today. Try again tomorrow, or ask an administrator to create the account for you.
ts-createaccount-statement-required: This wiki asks who you are and what you want to do here before it reviews a request.
ts-createaccount-statement-long: The statement is longer than 1,000 characters.
ts-createaccount-not-allowed: This wiki does not let visitors create accounts. Ask an administrator of the wiki for one.
ts-createaccount-not-allowed-user: Your account cannot create accounts for others on this wiki.
ts-challenge-nojs: This wiki asks your browser for a few seconds of computation before it creates an account, to slow down automated sign-ups. Nothing about you is sent anywhere else. Turn on JavaScript for this site to continue, or ask an administrator of the wiki to create the account for you.
ts-challenge-nojs-login: After several failed attempts to log in, this wiki asks your browser for a few seconds of computation before the next one. Nothing about you is sent anywhere else. Turn on JavaScript for this site to continue, or wait a few minutes and try again.
ts-challenge-retry: The browser's computation had to start again. Submit the form once it says it is ready.
ts-challenge-working: Your browser is doing a short computation that this wiki asks for…
ts-challenge-waiting: Almost ready. The form will be sent when the computation finishes.
ts-challenge-failed: The computation could not run. Reload the page to try again.
ts-login-join: Don't have an account? Create one
ts-login-pending: Your request for an account is waiting for review. Try again later.
ts-login-rejected: Your request for an account was not approved. The reviewer wrote: $1
ts-confirmaccounts-login: Log in to review account requests.
ts-confirmaccounts-none: There are no account requests waiting for review.
ts-confirmaccounts-reason-help: The requester is shown this when they next log in.
ts-confirmaccounts-reason-required: Give a reason for rejecting the request; the requester is shown it.
ts-confirmaccounts-approved: The request has been approved and the account created.
ts-confirmaccounts-gone: That request is no longer open.
ts-specialpages-createaccount: Create an account on this wiki.
ts-specialpages-confirmaccounts: Review requests for accounts, where this wiki reviews new accounts.
ts-login-wrongpassword: Incorrect username or password. Please try again.
ts-login-subsidiary: $1 is a subsidiary account. Subsidiary accounts sign in to tools with a bot password, not here.
ts-login-expired: Your session expired before the form was sent. Please try again.
ts-logout-question: Do you want to log out?
ts-not-found: There is no page at this address.
ts-api-unavailable: The site cannot reach its server just now. Please try again in a minute.
ts-api-too-old: The server is older than this version of the site expects. An administrator needs to update it.
ts-home-lead: $1 is a knowledge base of items, properties and domains, built on Triplespace.
ts-home-hint: Search by label, or go straight to an ID such as Q42 or a domain such as wikipedia.org.
ts-home-generated: This page is generated because the page $1 has not been written yet.
ts-no-special-page: There is no special page called $1.
ts-specialpages-search: Find items, properties and domains by label or alias, or go straight to one by its ID.
ts-specialpages-none: This site has no special pages to offer yet.
ts-api-unexpected: The server answered in a way the site could not read. Please try again; if it keeps happening, an administrator needs to look at it.
ts-permission-denied: You do not have permission to read this.
ts-entity-missing: There is no entity at "$1". It may never have existed, or it may have been deleted.
ts-kind-keyed: Named by its key, minted by no one
ts-edit-terms-label: Edit the label, description and aliases
ts-edit-conflict: Someone changed this entity after you began editing, so your change was not saved. Start again from the current version to see theirs.
ts-edit-reload: Start again from the current version
ts-edit-removed: This value will be removed when you save.
ts-edit-time-help: A year, a year and month, or a date: 1952, 1952-03 or 1952-03-11.
ts-edit-unsupported: This kind of value cannot be edited here yet.
ts-edit-need-entity: choose an item from the list.
ts-edit-need-monolingual: enter a text and a language code, such as en.
ts-edit-need-number: enter a number, such as 42 or 3.14.
ts-edit-need-time: enter a year, a year and month, or a date, such as 1952 or 1952-03-11.
ts-edit-need-coordinate: enter a latitude from −90 to 90 and a longitude from −180 to 180.
ts-best-value-tip: Queries and infoboxes return only this value
ts-unsourced: {{PLURAL:$1|$1 value has no source|$1 values have no source}}
ts-labels-caption: Labels, descriptions and aliases in every language
ts-labels-none: No labels in any language yet.
ts-sources-unknown: The server did not say where this comes from.
ts-specialpages-version: The software this wiki runs on, its licence and its credits.
ts-version-poweredby: This wiki is powered by $1, developed by $2 in $3.
ts-version-poweredby-contributors: This wiki is powered by $1, developed by $2 in $3, with contributions from $4.
ts-version-license-info: $1 is free software; you can redistribute it and/or modify it under the terms of the GNU General Public License as published by the Free Software Foundation; either version 3 of the License, or (at your option) any later version.
ts-version-license-warranty: $1 is distributed in the hope that it will be useful, but WITHOUT ANY WARRANTY; without even the implied warranty of MERCHANTABILITY or FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE. See the GNU General Public License for more details.
ts-version-license-copy: You should have received $1 along with this program; if not, see $2.
ts-version-license-copy-link: a copy of the GNU General Public License
ts-version-dual-and-cc0: The shared scatter-* crates are also available from $1 under a commercial licence. The documentation and registry data this software embeds are dedicated to the public domain under CC0 1.0.
ts-version-modified-unsourced: Modified build; source location not configured.
ts-version-components-unlisted: Development build: components are not listed.
ts-version-inspiredby-intro: $1 runs no MediaWiki extension. It implements features, names and APIs that MediaWiki and these extensions introduced, so that their users, tools and pages work here.
ts-version-agents-intro: $1's design records and code were written with these AI agents.
ts-version-credits-developer-only: $1 is developed by $2. There are no other contributors yet.
ts-version-license-no-files: This component ships no licence files.
ts-version-wikitext-count: Extension tags, parser functions, variables and switches ($1)
ts-newitem-intro: Give the new item a label, a description and any other names it is known by, in one language. Statements can be added on its page once it exists.
ts-newproperty-intro: Give the new property a label, a description, any other names it is known by, and its data type, which decides what values its statements take.
ts-newproperty-denied: You do not have permission to create properties.
ts-new-lang-help: The language of the label, description and aliases, as a code: en, de, pt-br.
ts-new-aliases-help: Separate several names with a vertical bar (|).
ts-new-statements-help: These are added with the new entity. Untick any you do not want.
ts-new-statement-malformed: "$1" is left out: a statement is written as a property ID, a colon and a value, such as P12:value.
ts-new-statement-no-property: "$2" is left out: there is no property $1.
ts-new-statement-unsupported: "$2" is left out: values of type $1 cannot be filled in here yet. Add it on the new entity's page.
ts-new-statement-bad-value: "$1" is left out: it is not a value of type $2.
ts-new-login: Log in to create items and properties.
ts-new-insufficient: Give at least a label, a description or an alias.
ts-new-expired: Your session expired before the form was sent. Check it and send it again.
ts-specialpages-newitem: Create an item, with its label, description and aliases in one language.
ts-specialpages-newproperty: Create a property, with its terms and its data type.
ts-contributions-intro: Enter a user name to see what they have changed.
ts-contributions-none: $1 has made no changes in this period.
ts-changes-flag-bot-title: This edit was made by a bot
ts-specialpages-recentchanges: The newest edits, jobs and log actions on this site.
ts-history-latest-only: Only the latest state from $1 is kept here; earlier states are not listed.
ts-history-none: No history is held for this entity.
ts-diff-nothing: This revision changed nothing in the entity.
ts-diff-missing: There is no such revision of this entity.
ts-diff-sync-no-summary: No summary of this sync was stored.
ts-oldid-banner: This is revision $1 of this entity, as $2 saved it on $3. It may differ from the current version.
ts-oldid-missing: Revision $1 is not a local revision of this entity.
ts-setting-account-approval-help: Whether registering files a request that a holder of confirmaccount approves, instead of creating the account at once (07 §2.6).
ts-setting-account-creation_limit-help: How many accounts one address may create (and requests it may file) in a day before registration is refused; noratelimit is exempt (07 §6.2).
ts-setting-account-request_expiry-help: How long an account request stays open before it is deleted.
ts-setting-account-request_statement-hel: Whether an account request asks for a statement of up to 1,000 characters.
ts-setting-blocks-max_rows-help: Bounds every list a block renders.
ts-setting-blocks-refresh_debounce-help: Coalesces the refresh of pages whose block dependencies changed.
ts-setting-category-collation-help: Sort order of a category's members.
ts-setting-challenge-bits-help: The base difficulty of a challenge, in leading zero bits of SHA-256: about 2^bits hashes.
ts-setting-challenge-max_bits-help: The highest difficulty: one bit is added for each account created from the caller's address key in the last 24 hours, up to this.
ts-setting-challenge-triggers-help: The acts a challenge guards (07 §2.6); the empty list turns challenges off.
ts-setting-constraints-scope-help: Which entities the constraint consumer checks on composition: local, the local-graph statements and the entities in the tenant's overlay; overlay; or all, which is a batch job with progress and never a per-event step (06).
ts-setting-content-licence-help: The tenant's content licence, checked against a repository's when it is added to pages.repos and on a push.
ts-setting-discussion-share-help: Whether a provider tenant's threads are shown read-only on reading tenants.
ts-setting-dumps-keep-help: Previous dumps of each format kept per scope.
ts-setting-entities-closure-help: Properties whose values are fetched transitively from every mirrored entity.
ts-setting-entities-mirror-help: What of a provider's entities is mirrored; properties are always at least on-demand.
ts-setting-entities-term_languages-help: The instance record sets the languages in which a mirrored entity's terms populate the shared rows of view.term (§2.3); a tenant's record only narrows the languages its own pages and API display, and never adds a language to the shared rows.
ts-setting-export-max_bytes-help: Cap on file contents in an export; over it, URLs are written.
ts-setting-export-max_entity_history-hel: Revisions per entity exported: the per-entity cap, lower than export.max_history, under which the export job folds per-revision entity export.
ts-setting-export-sync_revisions-help: An export up to this size streams.
ts-setting-federation-accept_fep8b32-hel: Accept FEP-8b32 object integrity proofs inbound.
ts-setting-federation-accept_rfc9421-hel: Accept RFC 9421 HTTP message signatures inbound.
ts-setting-federation-clock_skew-help: A request whose Date lies outside ± this is rejected.
ts-setting-federation-replay_window-help: How long an accepted activity's id is kept in ops.ap_inbox_seen.
ts-setting-federation-talk_pages-help: Which talk pages (and boards) are as:Group actors.
ts-setting-feeds-related_limit-help: Members past which a related-changes relation is truncated.
ts-setting-files-commons_repo-help: The repository that resolves commonsMedia values.
ts-setting-files-orphan_grace-help: Grace before the orphan sweep deletes an unreferenced object.
ts-setting-files-reclaim_after-help: After how long unreadable to universe a file version is erased; a tenant may set a shorter period, never a longer one.
ts-setting-files-repos-help: The file repositories a tenant uses, in lookup order.
ts-setting-files-separation-help: Whether each tenant's bytes are stored apart or identical bytes once; changing it is triplespace-cli files rescope, needing owner.
ts-setting-files-share-help: Whether this tenant's files may serve other tenants as a tenant repository; under providers.between_tenants = operator only the operator can set it.
ts-setting-files-thumb_widths-help: Requested widths are rounded up to the next entry.
ts-setting-files-types-help: The types the instance allows; a tenant site setting may narrow the list but not widen it.
ts-setting-follow-interval-help: How often a follower without an event stream polls the wiki's recent changes.
ts-setting-follow-settle-help: Within this of now, a poll reads by time from ten seconds before its position rather than by continuation.
ts-setting-follow-tail-help: How far behind the head the tail pass re-reads, and how long seen change IDs are remembered; PT0S turns the tail pass off.
ts-setting-fork-content_revisions-help: Revisions, counted from the newest, seeded with their text; the rest of the seeded history is metadata only, and dependencies and archives are never seeded with text.
ts-setting-fork-dependencies-help: Whether a fork copies its templates or leaves them to the repository.
ts-setting-fork-history_source-help: Where a fork's history is seeded from.
ts-setting-fork-max_dependencies-help: Stops a fork job that would copy more pages.
ts-setting-fork-max_revisions-help: The per-job budget: revisions, with or without text, a seeding job reads before it stops.
ts-setting-fork-refollow-help: Whether a fork that no longer differs from upstream is offered or automatically re-followed.
ts-setting-fork-refollow_after-help: Under auto, how long a fork must equal upstream before a job deletes it.
ts-setting-fork-talk-help: Default choice for a fork's talk page.
ts-setting-ingest-hash_mismatch-help: Whether a snak or reference hash that differs from upstream's is kept or aborts the job.
ts-setting-instance-owner_of_record-help: The instance's owner of record, shown on Special:Version where set.
ts-setting-instance-source_url-help: Where a modified build's source is published; a modified build without it shows "modified build; source location not configured", and instance check warns.
ts-setting-integrity-witness_partitions-: Which partitions' checkpoints are submitted to the witnesses.
ts-setting-integrity-witnesses-help: C2SP tlog-witness endpoints that cosign the tenant's checkpoints (01 §4.3).
ts-setting-login-issuers-help: The external issuers the wiki offers for login, of those with a client credential; * offers every one (07 §2.7).
ts-setting-login-password-help: Whether the built-in password issuer accepts logins.
ts-setting-lua-client_site-help: Which site Lua's Wikibase client is, and so which item a page is connected to.
ts-setting-lua-ids-help: What a bare one-letter ID means in Lua.
ts-setting-lua-unheld_ttl-help: Expiry of a recorded miss on an unheld entity.
ts-setting-mcp-facets-help: The properties offered as filters and facets.
ts-setting-mcp-scope-help: The scope the tools search within by default.
ts-setting-mcp-scopes-help: Other scopes a client may select per session.
ts-setting-media-base_url-help: The origin files are served from.
ts-setting-mediainfo-mirror-help: entities.mirror for Wikidata's type M, under its own name for compatibility.
ts-setting-notifications-fediverse_domai: Domains fediverse notifications may go to.
ts-setting-nuke-confirm_threshold-help: Items above which Special:Nuke asks for the target's name.
ts-setting-pages-repos-help: Page repositories, in inheritance order; replaces wikitext.template_repos.
ts-setting-pages-share-help: Whether this tenant's pages may serve other tenants as a tenant repository; replaces wikitext.share.
ts-setting-preferences-defaults-help: Defaults for registered preference keys on this wiki, merged key by key over the instance's default for this setting.
ts-setting-projections-sync_budget-help: Rows of composition fan-out the write path applies after commit before the rest is queued to the composition worker (03).
ts-setting-projections-sync_time-help: Time the write path spends on that fan-out, whichever comes first.
ts-setting-proposals-adoption_grace-help: After which a partly carried proposal is partly adopted.
ts-setting-proposals-direct_edit_lines-h: Lines a clean merge may change and still push to the article itself.
ts-setting-proposals-push-help: Whether proposals may be pushed upstream.
ts-setting-queries-max_scope_values-help: Members a scope may bind as VALUES.
ts-setting-query-cache_ttl-help: L2 lifetime of a GET /sparql response and of a query page's results.
ts-setting-query-embedded_max_triples-he: The triple count above which query.backend = embedded is refused: the embedded backend is the small profile's, and the Wikidata profile requires remote (02).
ts-setting-query-max_concurrent-help: Concurrent queries across the instance, beyond which a query waits up to its own timeout; a tenant cannot set it.
ts-setting-query-max_lag-help: Lag above which the service is unavailable.
ts-setting-query-timeout-help: Bounds every query, raw or compiled.
ts-setting-reclaim-vouching-help: Whether the wiki this one adopted vouches for its old users through that issuer, reclaiming their accounts at login; off, or an issuer code (07 §2.5).
ts-setting-repo-mirror_grace-help: A mirrored file unused this long is tombstoned.
ts-setting-reports-term_languages-help: Languages the missing-label and missing-description reports cover.
ts-setting-retention-api_max_entities-he: A bulk retain over this is refused for api unless forced.
ts-setting-retention-auto_properties-hel: Automatic retain of mirrored properties a tenant uses.
ts-setting-retention-default-help: The retention the tenant's policy applies to a mirrored entity an upstream tombstone removes, where no retain row names it; cascade is never a default and is only ever set per entity.
ts-setting-schemas-max_bound-help: Bound-schema × scope size above which binding a schema to a scope is refused at scope save, unless an operator raises the ceiling.
ts-setting-schemas-source-help: Validate against the query store instead.
ts-setting-scopes-facet_limit-help: Members below which the builder shows facets.
ts-setting-scopes-max_members-help: Bound on a scope's materialized members.
ts-setting-search-inherited-help: Whether pages-{repo} indexes are searched beside the tenant's.
ts-setting-signing-require_for_bot-help: Require a client signature for the bot group.
ts-setting-site-icon-help: The favicon and touch icon, served to anyone as a site asset, and general.favicon in siteinfo.
ts-setting-site-landing_text-help: Text on a private tenant's landing page.
ts-setting-site-language-help: The content language ($wgLanguageCode): general.lang in siteinfo, the default interface language, the language of Project page titles and the fallback for labels and reports.
ts-setting-site-logo-help: The logo in the global header and on a private tenant's landing page, and general.logo in siteinfo; served to anyone as a site asset.
ts-setting-site-name-help: The wiki's name: general.sitename in siteinfo, the global header, the Project namespace's name, the tenant list's name, and the operator's display name when the tenant is primary.
ts-setting-sprints-cache_ttl-help: L1 lifetime of the sp: key.
ts-setting-sprints-claim_ttl-help: A claim expires after this without a release.
ts-setting-sprints-max_claims-help: Live claims an actor may hold on a sprint.
ts-setting-storage-dedup_scope-help: Whether fragments are deduplicated per tenant or once for the instance.
ts-setting-subsidiaries-oauth_requires_a: Whether an OAuth-created subsidiary is pending.
ts-setting-subsidiaries-pending_ttl-help: A subsidiary still unapproved after this is retired.
ts-setting-talk-archive_window-help: Window within which a removed thread found on an archive subpage counts as archived.
ts-setting-talk-new_thread_default-help: Which destination the new-thread form selects.
ts-setting-talk-upstream_audit_days-help: How long a failed upstream send's text is kept.
ts-setting-talk-upstream_post-help: Whether replies and new sections may be sent upstream at all.
ts-setting-theme-choice-help: What readers may choose: any palette and type set the wiki offers, or only the accessibility choices (mode, contrast, text size, accessibility palettes and type sets), which are never withheld.
ts-setting-theme-palette-help: The wiki's palette: the colours of every page, for readers who have not chosen another.
ts-setting-theme-typeset-help: The wiki's type set: the typefaces of every page, for readers who have not chosen another.
ts-setting-thread-max_attachments-help: Home and listings of a thread together.
ts-setting-thread-max_depth-help: Depth to which a thread page indents its posts.
ts-setting-thread-markup-help: The markup of new posts: Markdown, or wikitext as on MediaWiki talk pages. Posts already written keep theirs.
ts-setting-ui-count_threshold-help: Counts above it (ref_count, revision counts) render as "10,000+" rather than exactly.
ts-setting-ui-theme-help: The theme a site is served with; refused when its colours fail WCAG 2.1 AA contrast.
ts-setting-updates-enabled-help: Whether the RDF delta consumer runs for this tenant, writing view.rdf_delta from composition events; off, no delta is computed and the update stream is unavailable (02).
ts-setting-upstream-retire_adopted-help: Retire a local assertion when upstream adopts it.
ts-setting-version-services-help: How much Special:Version discloses of the instance's services: everything, as MediaWiki shows its database version to everyone; names, roles and states without versions; or the build row only. Holders of ts-config at the farm base always see full.
ts-setting-wikitext-expansion-help: Expand templates and parser functions; enables Template and Template talk.
ts-setting-wikitext-lua-help: Lua modules. Requires wikitext.expansion = on; capped by wikitext.ceiling.
ts-setting-wikitext-renderer-help: Which stage-2 renderer serves HTML. parsoid requires expansion on and a Parsoid service on the instance.
ts-setting-wikitext-site_styles-help: The tenant's sanitized-css site styles page.
ts-setting-witness-enabled-help: Whether triplespace-server serves the C2SP tlog-witness API at the farm base for the listed origins (01 §4.3).
ts-pref-ts-upstream-fold: Show upstream edits inside each sync
ts-pref-ts-rc-syncs: Show mirror syncs in recent changes
ts-pref-feeds-syncs: Show syncs in watchlist and history
ts-pref-autowatch-edit: Watch pages and entities I edit
ts-pref-autowatch-create: Watch pages and entities I create
ts-pref-autowatch-notify: Notify me about what I watch automatically
ts-pref-threads-destination: Where new threads go on synced talk pages
ts-pref-notifications-talk-email: Email me about messages on my talk page
ts-tenancy-providers-between_tenants: Wikis as providers to each other
ts-appearance-nojs: This page follows your device's settings. Log in, or turn on JavaScript, to keep your own choices.
ts-preferences-appearance-note: These are also in the Appearance menu at the top of every page.
ts-preferences-restore-intro: Return every preference to the wiki's default.
ts-preferences-restored: All your preferences are back to the defaults.
ts-preferences-anon: Preferences belong to an account. Log in to set yours.
ts-preferences-anon-appearance: Colour mode, contrast and text size can be chosen without an account, in the Appearance menu at the top of the page. They are kept in this browser.
ts-preferences-denied: Your account may not change its preferences here.
ts-specialpages-preferences: Your interface language, appearance, history and watching options.
ts-specialpages-wikisettings: This wiki's settings: its name, language, features and limits.
ts-specialpages-instancesettings: The instance's settings, its tenancy policy and its defaults for wikis.
ts-settings-read-only: You can read these settings. Changing them needs the right to configure this wiki.
ts-settings-unresolved-default: The instance's default names something this wiki does not have, so the registry default applies.
ts-settings-tenancy-wiki: The instance's tenancy policy, as it applies to this wiki. Only the instance can change it.
ts-settings-tenancy-instance: The tenancy policy: what wikis on this instance share, and what the instance decides for them.
ts-settings-defaults-intro: A wiki that has not set a setting itself uses the instance's default, and follows it when it changes.
ts-settings-defaults-intro-locks: A wiki that has not set a setting itself uses the instance's default, and follows it when it changes. A locked setting is the instance's for every wiki.
ts-settings-inheriting: {{PLURAL:$1|One wiki uses|$1 wikis use}} this default, and will change with it.
ts-settings-conflict: Someone changed this setting after you opened the page. Check its value and save again.
ts-settings-denied: You may not change this setting.
ts-settings-locked: The instance has locked this setting.
ts-login-external-heading: Or log in with another account
ts-login-external-note: This wiki learns which account you hold there, and nothing else. Nobody else can see which service you log in with.
ts-createaccount-external-heading: Or create an account with another account you hold
ts-createaccount-pending-intro: You signed in with $1 as $2. No account on this wiki logs in with it yet: choose a name for this wiki to create one. No password is needed.
ts-createaccount-pending-suggest-note: Using the same name makes your two accounts easy to connect.
ts-createaccount-requested-next-external: Someone who reviews new accounts on this wiki will decide on it. Log in the same way again to learn the outcome.
ts-oauth-denied: You did not allow this wiki to learn which account you hold there, so you were not logged in.
ts-oauth-state: That sign-in has expired or did not begin here. Please start again.
ts-oauth-failed: The account provider could not be reached or gave an answer this wiki did not understand. Please try again later.
ts-oauth-unavailable: This wiki does not offer logging in with that provider.
ts-oauth-bound: That account already logs in to an account on this wiki. Log in with it instead.
ts-oauth-bound-elsewhere: That account already logs in to another account on this wiki.
ts-last-binding: This is your only way to log in, so it cannot be removed.
ts-reclaimed: Welcome back: the wiki this one was moved from confirmed that this account is yours.
ts-reclaim-taken: The wiki this one was moved from says this is your account, but someone already holds it here. Ask a bureaucrat.
ts-reclaim-unavailable: The wiki this one was moved from could not be asked who you are. Please try again later.
ts-login-rejected-external: Your request for an account was not approved.
ts-account-unavailable: This wiki no longer offers logging in with it.
ts-account-remove-last: Your only way to log in cannot be removed. Add another first.
ts-account-remove-note: Removing a sign-in method erases it from this wiki's records.
ts-account-remove-failed: The sign-in method could not be removed.
ts-account-login-needed: Log in to see your account.
ts-page-old-revision: This is an old revision of this page.
ts-page-missing: There is currently no text in this page.
ts-page-no-revision: There is no revision $1 of this page, or it is not yours to see.
ts-page-bad-title: "$1" cannot be the title of a page.
ts-pageedit-preview-note: This is only a preview; your changes have not been saved yet.
ts-pageedit-conflict: Someone else changed this page after you started editing. Your text is kept in the form, and the current version is shown below it: merge your changes into your text and save again.
ts-pageedit-failed: The page could not be saved: $1
ts-pageedit-unsupported: Pages of the content model $1 cannot be edited here yet.
ts-newpage-intro: Enter the title of the page to create, for example Project:Guidelines.
ts-pagediff-missing: One of these revisions does not exist, or its text is not yours to see.
ts-pagediff-bad: This address does not name two revisions to compare.
ts-protect-denied: You do not have permission to protect this page.
ts-protect-missing: There is no such page, or it is not yours to see.
ts-protect-new-title: This page does not exist yet. A restriction here reserves the title: a "Create" restriction decides who may create it.
ts-protect-locked-out: You must be a member of the group you restrict reading to, and of the group of a reading restriction you change or lift.
ts-protect-policy: This wiki's hosting policy does not allow reading restrictions.
ts-protect-unknown-group: There is no such group on this wiki.
ts-protect-invalid-expiry: The expiry is not a time this wiki understands.
ts-protect-help-edit: Only members of the chosen group may edit this page.
ts-protect-help-move: Only members of the chosen group may move this page.
ts-protect-help-create: Only members of the chosen group may create this page.
ts-protect-read-help: Only members of the chosen group will see this page at all; everyone else is told it does not exist. You must be in that group yourself. Your groups: $1.
ts-protect-talk-help: The talk page and the discussions on it are hidden with the page. Leave this off to keep the discussion open.
ts-specialpages-userrights: Change which groups an account is in.
ts-userrights-login: Log in to change user rights.
ts-userrights-user-help: The name of the account whose groups to show.
ts-userrights-nosuchuser: There is no account by that name.
ts-userrights-nothing-changeable: You may not change any of these groups.
ts-userrights-expiry-help: "infinite", a time such as 2027-01-01T00:00:00Z, or a span such as "1 week".
ts-userrights-expiry-self-help: Adding yourself to a group is logged publicly. A short membership is proposed, since a look at one page needs no standing membership; clear it for an indefinite one.
ts-userrights-reason-help: Recorded in the public rights log.
ts-userrights-denied-group: You may not make that change: $1
ts-userrights-last-owner: That would leave the wiki without an owner for something only owners hold: $1
ts-specialpages-protectedpages: The restrictions in force on pages, entities and sets, and the groups they name.
ts-protectedpages-sets-help: A set restricts every page in it at once. You see the sets you may read.
ts-protectedpages-no-sets: There are no sets you may read.
ts-protectedpages-set-read-help: Only members of this group will see the set's pages; you must be in it yourself.
ts-protectedpages-empty-groups-help: Groups that a reading restriction names and that nobody is in. A holder of user rights can join one to reach what it hides.
ts-protectedpages-empty-groups-none: Every group a restriction names has a member.
ts-protectedpages-done-added: The page was added to the set.
ts-protectedpages-done-removed: The page was removed from the set.
ts-protectedpages-no-page: There is no such page, or it is not yours to see.
ts-protectedpages-already-member: That page is already in the set.
ts-specialpages-block: Block an account from editing, or unblock one.
ts-block-denied: You do not have permission to block accounts.
ts-block-reason-help: Recorded in the public block log and shown to the account.
ts-block-nocreate-help: The blocked account may not create other accounts either.
ts-block-allbutread-help: Removes every right but read. Off, a block removes editing and page creation.
ts-block-hidename-help: The name is shown only to the suppression group, everywhere. Needs an indefinite block; an unblock by a holder of that right shows the name again.
ts-block-reblock-help: Without this, an account already blocked is left as it is.
ts-block-already: That account is already blocked. Turn on "Replace the current block" to change it.
ts-block-hide-indefinite: A username can be hidden only with an indefinite block.
ts-unblock-hidden-note: If the account's name is hidden, it stays hidden: only a holder of the right to hide usernames shows it again.
ts-settings-visibility-now: Who may read this wiki now: $1
ts-settings-visibility-group-help: You must be in the group you choose. Your groups: $1.
ts-settings-visibility-warning: Making the wiki private withdraws it from every reader it had and purges its public copies. Visitors see only the site name, the landing text and a login link. Account creation keeps working unless the wiki closes it.
ts-settings-visibility-denied: Changing the wiki's visibility needs the right to configure the wiki.
ts-moderation-denied: You do not have the $1 right.
ts-delete-warning: Deleting removes the page from readers outside the deletion group. Its history is kept and it can be undeleted.
ts-delete-talk-help: The talk page and the discussions on it go with the page.
ts-deleted-banner: This page was deleted by $1 on $2: $3
ts-deleted-banner-no-reason: This page was deleted by $1 on $2.
ts-specialpages-log: Deletions, protections, rights changes, blocks and the other logged actions.
ts-specialpages-blocklist: The accounts blocked now, and until when.
ts-specialpages-undelete: Deleted pages, and the way to restore one.
ts-undelete-intro: Recent deletions you may see. Open one to read it and restore it.
ts-undelete-nothing: There is no deletion of $1 that you may see.

ts-move-redirect-help: Without one, the old title stops resolving.
ts-move-subpages-help: Every page under the old title, each leaving its own redirect.
ts-move-exists: A page with that title already exists.
ts-move-restricted: That title is reserved, or you may not create a page there.
ts-move-immobile: Pages of this kind cannot be moved, or not to that namespace.
ts-move-self: The new title is the same as the old one.
ts-move-invalid: That is not a valid title.
ts-specialpages-movepage: Rename a page, leaving a redirect.
ts-protectedpages-set-needs-restriction: A set restricts something: choose a group for Read or Edit.
ts-talk-empty: There are no discussions on this page yet.
ts-talk-no-subject: This talk page belongs to a page that does not exist.

ts-thread-markup-wikitext: Posts on this wiki use wikitext.
ts-thread-login: Log in to take part in this discussion
ts-thread-refused-ts-empty-post: Your post has no text. Write something, or choose a status.
ts-thread-refused-badtoken: Your session ran out. Your text is kept below; post it again.
ts-thread-refused-ts-bad-subject: That subject cannot be a thread's title. Try different words.
ts-changes-thread-move-away: moved the thread to another page
ts-changes-thread-attach: listed the thread on another page
ts-changes-thread-detach: removed the thread from a page
ts-changes-thread-detach-here: removed the thread from this page
ts-orange-bar: You have a new message on $1.

ts-notifications-login: Log in to see your notifications.
ts-notif-talk: $1 posted in $2 on your talk page.
ts-notif-rights: $1 changed your group memberships or blocks.
ts-notif-group-join: $2 joined a group you are in.
ts-specialpages-watchlist: Changes to the pages, entities and threads you watch.
ts-watchlist-login: Log in to see your watchlist.
ts-watchlist-none: No changes to what you watch.
ts-specialpages-editwatchlist: What you watch, for how long, and whether it notifies you.
ts-editwatchlist-count: You are watching $1 pages, entities and threads. A talk page is watched with its subject.

ts-specialpages-redirect: Go to a page by its page ID, or to a revision by its revision ID.
ts-specialpages-entitypage: Go to an item's or property's page by its ID.

ts-redirects-bad-title: "$1" is not a title a page can have.

ts-redirects-no-revision: There is no revision $1, or it is not yours to see.
